Record multiple takes in each board section

Open a section, click Record, then Stop to save. Listen and choose Use this take to queue an audio export for editing.

Recording requires a Lavish server with the recording feature.

Storage and handoff

Saved audio belongs to this board's canonical file path and the section id. Keep section ids stable when revising a board in place. A new board file gets a separate recording collection. Recordings remain in the server's local state directory after closing the browser. Download important takes as a separate backup.

Use this take queues the path of an unchanged local export. Press Send to Agent when your notes are ready. Exported audio survives deleting its take from the list. HTML export and hosted sharing omit the recordings.
